_comment: Caveat list for input/master-resume.md, the one master resume. Read at Step 2 and applied at Step 3 of .claude/skills/resume-jd-optimizer/SKILL.md. Only global_caveats and no_fit.keywords are live: they say what this record cannot claim and what to log when a posting asks for it. 'tracks' is kept empty because track selection no longer exists; the skill reads caveats from it and from global_caveats alike. Rebuilt 2026-09-23 for the record in input/master-resume.md and input/projects.md.

global_caveats.log: No engineering outcome in input/projects.md carries a measured result: every entry reads 'None recorded'. Bullets are qualitative on every run, and no percentage, time saving or volume may be written. This is the single largest gap in the record. The four numbers worth chasing first are the size of the Indeed Spring Boot to Node.js migration, what the revenue metrics overhaul changed, what the Amazon debugging tool changed about diagnosis time, and what the first CI suite at Josh DeShong Real Estate caught.

Record supports roughly 8 years of professional software engineering since August 2017, across Pure Storage, Josh DeShong Real Estate, Amazon and Indeed, with breaks between roles. Internships, the teaching assistant role and the C2 Education teaching role are not engineering years. Titles held are Software Engineer and Software Development Engineer, never Senior, Staff or Principal, so do not inflate the headline. If the posting makes the year count or the seniority a hard bar, log a structural mismatch.

'Core contributor' is the profile's own wording on both major pieces of work, the Indeed migration and the Amazon debugging tool. Mentoring new hires and interviewing candidates at Josh DeShong Real Estate are evidenced; leading engineers, owning an architecture and managing people are not. Never write led, drove, headed or architected.

Cloud work is AWS application-level: Lambda, EC2, ECS, DynamoDB, IAM, CloudWatch and CDK. No cluster, orchestration, infrastructure-as-code tool beyond CDK, service mesh, platform ownership or production on-call rotation is recorded. The Pure Storage rotation investigated high-priority test failures, not production incidents. Claim none of it.

The record names MongoDB, DynamoDB and Neo4j and nothing else. No relational database, no SQL, no warehouse and no ETL or streaming tooling appears anywhere. A posting built on any of them is a structural mismatch, not something to bridge to.

No AI or machine learning work by this candidate is recorded. The CognitiveScale internship built an application on top of that company's insights platform; it is not model development, evaluation or MLOps. Report a structural mismatch rather than bridging to it.

No regulated-data or compliance work is recorded. The CognitiveScale healthcare internship application is not compliance experience. Claim none of it, and do not write a domain tag the record cannot stand behind.

No Agile, Scrum, Kanban, sprint, standup or retrospective evidence of any kind is recorded. The values may be listed in a Technical Skills row when the posting names them, and claimed in no bullet, summary or letter.
No GitHub URL and no open-source contribution is recorded. Section 6 of input/profile.md is empty, so the field is omitted from the contact line. Add a real URL to close this.
Nothing in the record answers these. They come from the candidate, always, and never from a guess: see the Step 10 rules in house-style.md.

no_fit._comment: The record does not cover these disciplines. Still generate from input/master-resume.md, and log the mismatch at Step 8. Matching is on word boundaries: 'kotlin' is deliberately absent here because the record evidences Kotlin as an Amazon backend language, not as mobile development.
no_fit.log: JD is outside what the record covers. Generated from input/master-resume.md, with no claim bridged to the missing discipline.
